nodes.title: Detail evidence capability-reference shape hotfix
nodes.summary: The one corrective task that fixes case-simulation-cockpit-adapters.ts's own Detail evidence reading its capability reference as a nested object no simulate response ever sends.

nodes.title: Detail panel Criterion 6 comment-wording hotfix
nodes.summary: The one corrective task that rewords case-simulation-detail-panel.tsx's own Criterion 6 comment so it no longer conflates a per-hypothesis fact with an investigation-wide one.

nodes.title: Read the Detail evidence's capability reference as the two flat fields the wire actually sends
nodes.summary: Fixes toDetailEvidence (case-simulation-cockpit-adapters.ts) and the Evidence tab's capability line (case-simulation-detail-evidence-tab.tsx) to read capability_name/capability_version as flat fields, matching both simulate endpoints' real wire shape, instead of a nested capability: { name, version } object that neither endpoint ever sends.

nodes.title: Reword the Detail panel's Criterion 6 comment to separate the per-hypothesis fact from the investigation-wide one
nodes.summary: Corrects case-simulation-detail-panel.tsx's own header comment, which currently groups model, prompt version, token usage and elapsed time as one undifferentiated "judgment" set, into two correctly-attributed facts.
